channel.title: Who Are These Podcasts?
channel.description: Hosted by Karl and a variety of guest cohosts, WATP navigates the murky waters of today’s popular and not-so-popular podcasts. They offer honest reviews that break the 4th wall of broadcasting and sometimes make sensitive podcasters cry a little. Simply put, they’re listening so you don’t have to. Subscribe to Who Are These Podcasts wherever you listen to podcasts.

item.title: Ep776 - JoJo Schaub on TFATK, Bill Burr, Opie Unfiltered, Jerry Banfield
item.itunes:title: JoJo Schaub on TFATK, Bill Burr, Opie Unfiltered, Jerry Banfield
item.itunes:author: WhoAreThese.com
item.content:encoded:
After a quick stop at the Mario Bosco cringe factory, we check in on Bill Burr who is interviewing Ann Wilson. Well, not so much interviewing her as he is telling her all about his experiences with standup. He can’t figure out how to ask a question succinctly and seems to me more concerned with Ann appreciating him than trying to get to know anything about her. 

Adam Busch was checking out Brendan Schaub’s wife, Mrs. Bapa, on The Fighter and the Kid. For some reason they’re still pretending their 10-year-old son is a famous athlete that we’re all following. And they’re also pretending that Brendan is a great coach who always knows the right things to say. Jerry Banfield had just about the best day of his life. He woke up to two new friends (who are rich) and $1,000! I can’t believe he doesn’t see that these people are not looking out for his best interest and this will end very badly. Just kidding, I can believe that. Opie is now going overboard with information about his family. I thought his daughter needed him to get out of bed, eat breakfast, and get to volleyball practice. Now it turns out she has a whole life outside of the Hughes’ family. Poor Gregg. And wait until Opie tries to “Jocktober” 2 Bears, 1 Cave. As Shaggy would say, Zoinks! Megan and Annie join us for a round of “Is It Gay?” and the Opie or Burr game. We wrap things up with Spotify comments, reviews, and your voicemails.

item.title: Ep775 - Danny Bevins, Opie, Jerry Banfield, Marcelo Schneider
item.description:
This week we’re checking in on professional standup comedian Danny Bevins. Oh, you’ve never heard of him? Well he’s posting regularly on Facebook and just put out a special on YouTube five months ago that has almost one-thousand views. Let’s find out what the world is missing out on.
Tab Birt joins us to watch YouTuber Danny Sapko who has exposed a virtuoso musician, bass player Marcelo Perez Schneider. He plays so fast it doesn’t seem possible. And it turns out it isn’t. It’s like Ken Tamplin all over again. Jerry Banfield has a new t-shirt that’s going to solve all of his financial problems. But even if that’s figured out, he still needs a lady friend. Solution - dump your kids and go to South Africa. This one is wild even by Jerry’s standards. Opie and Ron are not getting along, they’re bickering more than ever. Erik Marino joins and it seems like each guy thinks they’re the only funny one. We finish with Internet News.

item.title: Ep774 - Pauly Shore, Opie w/Ron & Erik, Jerry Banfield, Richard Ojeda
item.description:
This we after a quick look at Anthony Cumia and Jim Norton discussing the Dabbleverse, we’re transported to Pauly Shore’s studio apartment in Hollywood. Pauly has made a lot of bad decisions and finds himself down on his luck in finances, love, and career. Wait, is any of this true? That’s the debate as we watch this man spiral for our amusement.
Adam Busch is not impressed with David Lee Roth’s latest video / phone prank. Longtime Stuttering John political partner Richard Ojeda makes an appearance on the political show Breaking Points with Krystal & Saagar. He is very passionate and fired up about billionaires but he has a solution that may or may not involved curb stomping. On Opie Radio we find out that Erik Marino may not understand comedy but he’s an expert on candy. Based on his teeth this comes as no surprise. Ron the Waiter is over-the-top with his racism this week and either Opie doesn’t notice or doesn’t mind. Jerry Banfield is literally blaming the world for his current situation which is so rich. It’s interesting that his best friends Gemini, GhatGPT, and Claude don’t take any of the blame. We have a brand new Jerry game from Barry Janfield. Megan and Annie join the program for “Is It Gay?” and the Opie or Burr game. We finish up with comments, reviews, and your voicemails. 
WATP candy available now: https://www.leiselandfriendsgourmet.com/

item.title: Ep773 - The John Clay Wolfe Show, Jerry, Opie & Ron, Robbie Goodwin w/Christian Bladt
item.description:
We’re celebrating Jocktober this week with a Saturday morning syndicated radio show. Meet John Clay Wolfe and his crew - the Wolfe Pack. How clever. This is a used car salesman turned radio host so callers, be ready to tell him make, model, color, and mileage. When JCW and the gang try a remote it’s unintentionally hilarious. 
Christian Bladt joins the show to discuss Miss Judy getting featured on Cringe of the Week. Artie Fletcher eulogizes Gallagher in only the way Artie can, by exaggerating his own career achievements. Robbie Goodwin is a terrible comedian and tryhard impressionist. If you don’t know who he is, he once lost to Tom Myers in a roast battle. Pretty much sums it up. Opie and Erik (America) Marino really know how to drive a bit into the ground. You know you’re failing when even Ron the Waiter can’t get on board. Wait until you hear Opie’s hot take on Top Gun. Jerry Banfield struck a guy’s channel for copyright, something he swore he would never do. Jerry explains why. Also, he’s no longer pleasuring himself in hopes that will make him desperate enough that he’ll settle for a 5 or 6. That’s our Jerry, he’s the best! We finish with your voicemails.
Check out Christian’s podcast: https://www.youtube.com/@TheBladtcast/

item.title: Ep772 - Bill Burr Interviews, Opie w/Ron & Erik, Jerry Banfield, Chad Zumock
item.itunes:title: Bill Burr Interviews, Opie w/Ron & Erik, Jerry Banfield, Chad Zumock
item.itunes:author: WhoAreThese.com
item.content:encoded:
Kevin Brennan claims to still be in SAG and paying his dues. Adam Busch doesn’t think this is possibly true; he’s not even sure that KB is paying his taxes. Chad Zumock filmed his special over three nights and never told any of his supporters or producers. He promised all of them tickets to the show and instead recorded it while opening for Jim Florentine. Then he has the balls to call out Patrick Melton’s GoFundMe. 

Bill Burr had a guest on his podcast, fellow standup comic Nimesh Patel. Bill has zero curiosity about his guest and rather than ask him any questions or have a discussion with, Bill just talks at Nimesh like the guy is an audience member of a lecture. David Lee Roth is partying by himself and living in the past in a way that actually makes me jealous. NJ Ranger thinks he’s proven that Adam Busch was still standing by Danny Masterson’s side but there’s just one problem with NJR’s research, it all comes from a single source - Danny Masterson’s Instagram page. Opie has decided to surround himself with the worst of the worst. We thought Ron the Waiter was bad but then we discovered Erik "America" Marino. He pines for the days of Vic Henley. These guys are easily the worst podcast sidekicks anyone could ever find! The Jerry Banfield cycle continues as his latest idea is to go local! He’s pretty sad that he can’t sell any of his dumb crap to anyone. I bought a game from him for $9, so there’s that! Speaking of games, the “Name That Tune” Karmic edition created by Barry Janfield rules! We finish up with “Is It Gay?”, the Opie or Burr game, your comments and voicemails.

WATP candy available now: https://www.leiselandfriendsgourmet.com/

item.title: Ep771 - The Preston & Steve Show, Jerry Banfield, Opie & Ron, Kevin Brennan
item.description:
We’re officially celebrating Jocktober with Philadelphia’s “The Preston & Steve Show.” These guys have had a morning show for decades and are mostly pretty buttoned up. Unfortunately Marisa stinks, can’t hit the right drops, or know anything about anything.
Erik Nagel joins us to explain how the chance to win $1,000 isn’t really a chance to win that money. Myster Magenta wrote a new parody song for Stuttering John and his attorney Tabber Benedict posted a ridiculously dramatic update on LinkedIn. Long-time Kevin Brennan ballwasher Panhandler returns to Misery Loves Company after his phone number was doxxed by KB. Kevin can’t defend himself. He’s had a total break from reality. Jerry Banfield has discovered a way to trick his mind in order to succeed. Before that he was really down on himself. It seems the mounting debt and little hope to pay it off is starting to take its toll. Opie’s FU Friday was epic. It’s never been more obvious that Opie is cash poor and his “friends” are losers. He’s starting to lose patience. I doubt Erik Marino will be a cohost much longer. We finish with Internet News and your voicemails.
Vote for Erik Nagel: https://tophost.org/2026/erik-nagel

item.title: Ep770 - Stuttering John Returns, Jerry Banfield, Kevin Brennan, Opie w/Tony P and Anthony Cumia
item.itunes:title: Stuttering John Returns, Jerry Banfield, Kevin Brennan, Opie w/Tony P and Anthony Cumia
item.itunes:author: WhoAreThese.com
item.content:encoded:
Helga Mann is back with a new pilot episode of That Reality Show from her new place in the desert. She’s out of practice. And speaking of out of practice, Stuttering John has been recording some new cameos. He announces that he’s coming back to show business. We’re here when you’re ready, John.

Opie and Ron the Waiter have been TRASHING Tony P. ever since he did a guest spot with Jim Norton. We bring Tony on to live react to the sh*t talking. Anthony Cumia joins the show to explain how difficult it is to work with Opie. Ron actually thinks Opie has the bigger platform and that Tony P. is missing out on all of the opportunities that come with being a part of Opie Unfiltered. Jerry Banfield had an epiphany and thinks he finally came up with the product that’s going to get him out of debt. He keeps finding new ways to repackage selling his advice, a thing literally no one wants or needs. Kevin Brennan had Wayne Federman on his show, a rare celebrity guest. Both men regret this appearance. KB stepped in it as he tried to clown Adam Busch, not realizing that Wayne and Adam are friends who have worked together on a number of projects. The next day Kevin decides to cope by threatening to sue Adam. Megan and Annie join the show as we finish up with “Is It Gay?”, the Opie or Burr game, recent comments, reviews, and your voicemails.

WATP candy available now: https://www.leiselandfriendsgourmet.com/

item.title: Ep769 - IDIOT with Laura Clery, StutJo Loses the LOLsuit, Jerry, Opie
item.description:
Laura Clery is an extremely successful social media personality. She and her husband were both rich and famous. But they are also both crazy and have completely fucked up their lives. Somehow, after doing everything he could do to ruin Laura’s life, they have gotten back together for a podcast episode this week. The stories are pretty wild.
WATP founding cohost Kevin is in studio and Lucy Tightbox joins the show to discuss how insufferable this couple has always been. Moody is making AI podcast episodes about Aaron Imholte that are awesome. Jerry Banfield cried himself to sleep then woke up with tons of great ideas to make money and get himself out of debt. How is it that the products Jerry sells keep getting more ridiculous and far-fetched? I’m here for it! Opie and his pals Erik Marino and Ron the Waiter are still bashing Tony P. They can’t get over the fact that Tony doesn’t need them. Hurt people hurt people, or so I’ve been told. Stuttering John lost the lolsuit in the most spectacular way possible. As my attorney Danny Cevallos said - “total victory.” Next up, Anthony Cumia is suing John. We finish with the Internet News.
Lucy’s channel: https://www.youtube.com/@OnceOverwithCayley

item.content:encoded:
Laura Clery is an extremely successful social media personality. She and her husband were both rich and famous. But they are also both crazy and have completely fucked up their lives. Somehow, after doing everything he could do to ruin Laura’s life, they have gotten back together for a podcast episode this week. The stories are pretty wild.

WATP founding cohost Kevin is in studio and Lucy Tightbox joins the show to discuss how insufferable this couple has always been. Moody is making AI podcast episodes about Aaron Imholte that are awesome. Jerry Banfield cried himself to sleep then woke up with tons of great ideas to make money and get himself out of debt. How is it that the products Jerry sells keep getting more ridiculous and far-fetched? I’m here for it! Opie and his pals Erik Marino and Ron the Waiter are still bashing Tony P. They can’t get over the fact that Tony doesn’t need them. Hurt people hurt people, or so I’ve been told. Stuttering John lost the lolsuit in the most spectacular way possible. As my attorney Danny Cevallos said - “total victory.” Next up, Anthony Cumia is suing John. We finish with the Internet News.

item.description:
After playing Big Jay talking WATP on Legion of Skanks, we get right into Stand Up For Standup. This might be the dumbest "cause" you've ever heard of. Comics who aren't very good aren't getting a payday for things they did long ago after collecting money for years.
Opie’s former cohost Tony P joins the show to talk about the fallout with Gregg Hughes after Tony did a guest spot with Jim Norton. Opie does everything he can to keep his podcast partners from learning the truth. Tony reacts to Ron and Opie trashing him! We also bring in Matt who was at the show and gives us his take on how Tony did. Kevin Brennan wants to get gigs at the Comedy Cellar but when he goes down to the venue they won’t even let him in. Jerry Banfield has changed his business model again and is as bipolar as ever! He’s got a brand new product that will get him out of debt and it has to be his worst idea yet! Megan and Annie join the show for “Is It Gay?”, the Opie or Burr game, and your reviews.

item.title: Ep766 - Eric The Actor, Jerry Banfield, Opie, Kevin Brennan, Aaron Imholte
item.description:
After another nonsensical story from the 80s delivered by David Lee Roth, we check in on Kevin Brennan. The man is a shell of what he once was. He’s alone and lost and very likely drunk. Adam decided it’s time to go easy on him. 
Vinnie and I had a brief quarrel on the Creep Off, Pat Dixon and Bob Levy break it down. Eric the Actor made demands to the Howard Stern Show and their listeners that are almost identical to Stuttering John leaving the Dabbleverse. Aaron Imholte is embarrassed by his own show and missing the goal consistently is really getting to him. He’s very angry with the clip channel So Thorough Joe Burrow, so he lies about what the channel is doing. We show you what’s really happening. After proving he doesn't understand anything that made the Opie and Anthony Show one of the greatest comedy shows of all time, Opie loses his mind on Anthony during a pent-up rant that even takes Ron by surprise. Jerry Banfield is in Dallas for VidSummit, an event full of other online streamers. He doesn’t seem to be interested in networking or learning, he just wants to get recognized. We analyze his latest business model - Jerry is regressing. Megan and Annie join us for a round of “Is It Gay?” and Simon’s “Opie or Burr.” We finish with comments, reviews, and voicemails.

item.title: Ep764 - Lil Hard Knocks, Jerry Banfield, MLC, Opie & Ron, Steel Toe, Hunter Biden
item.itunes:title: Lil Hard Knocks, Jerry Banfield, MLC, Opie & Ron, Steel Toe, Hunter Biden
item.itunes:author: WhoAreThese.com
item.content:encoded:
After complaining about getting an erroneous strike from YouTube, we check in on Matan Even interviewing Hunter Biden. I don’t know why Hunter is on this media tour. It would be better if he was still a crackhead. 

Aaron Imholte had a self-proclaimed crash out as the pressure of pretending to be a successful streamer is getting to him. It’s so embarrassing that he had to go on his show the next morning and cope. Brendan Schaub has created the most self-indulgent video series ever. After calling out Kim Kardashian for her new reality show about parents who are too passionate about little league baseball, Brendan released a multi-part series about coaching his son’s peewee football team. We cover the web series and all of the hypocrisy. Kevin Brennan was given all of Adam Busch’s paystubs because that’s what he demanded in order to have Adam on the show. Turns out, it was never about the paystubs. KB just needed an excuse to not face Adam. What an absolute pussy. Jerry Banfield had the best night so far this year at the strip club. He got taken for over $2,000 but he doesn’t have a single regret, even though he received zero sexual gratification. But who would want that at a strip club? Opie and Ron are answering back to Anthony Cumia’s DM. They aren’t sure which angle to take. Are they better than Anthony? Is Ron funnier than Jim Norton? Or is it pathetic that Anthony is paying any attention to Opie’s cohost who is practically homeless? We finish up with a round of “Opie or Burr?” and your voicemails.

item.title: Ep763 - Howard Stern on HBO, Jerry Banfield, Opie & Ron
item.description:
Howard Stern has a new TV show on HBO Max. Someone thought it would be a good idea to take Howard’s fledging, one-day-a-week satellite radio show and turn it into a weekly videocast. No one was listening, so who will be watching? This first episode will get more eyeballs than any other and they couldn’t have put out a worse product.
Trucker Andy and MLP join the show to point out all of the reasons the Michael Rapaport phony phone call was fake, phony, and unfunny. Opie’s FU Friday with Tony P and Ron the Waiter was mostly wallpaper. Then Ron decided to promote his comedy show by explaining that he’s funnier than Jim Norton. Not only that, he said that everyone on his comedy show is better than Norton and the other comics featured at the Cellar. Is Ron really this dumb? Jerry Banfield wrote a book about his time being a police officer and it’s literally all over the place. He’s selling the shirt he wore on WATP on eBay because he thinks it might be worth thousands of dollars. Wait, is it worth thousands of dollars? Only Jerry can be $200k in debt and love every minute of it. Is he way smarter than the rest of us or just too dumb to comprehend what he’s doing? We finish with Internet News and your voicemails.
Andy’s channel: https://www.youtube.com/@StaySorry

item.title: Ep762 - Jerry Interview! Club Random, Sophie Rain, Kevin Brennan
item.description:
We start off by checking in on Drew Lane’s show. He had Dave Landau on and they talk about Chad Zumock raising money for a special using GoFundMe. Dave has a new special out available now on YouTube.
Bill Maher had the most successful OnlyFans model on Club Random. He is totally smitten with Sophie Rain and even lets her explain all of the superheroes in the Avengers. She has a couple of whoppers but Bill lets them go. Cringe of the Week is WATB’s mishandling of SuperChats. Jerry Banfield joins the show thanks to Vinnie Paulino. This interview is a wild ride!! We talk about his past lives, his ex-wife, his debt, failed business ventures, penis size and so much more! Jerry is an open book and we love that about him! Kevin Brennan has completely abandoned comedy. He shows all the signs of a demonic cult leader. It used to be a comedic device, to thrive on hate, but now it’s all he has left. There is no winking. He needs it to survive. He openly fights against anything resembling love, friendship or comedy. There are no laughs. Megan and Annie join the show for “Is It Gay?” and “Opie or Burr.” We finish up with your comments and voicemails.

item.title: Ep761 - Gender Spiral, Jim Thornton, Jerry Banfield, Opie & Ron
item.description:
Jim Thornton was the announcer for the Wheel of Fortune up until the time when someone took a photo of him typing in a pedophile chatroom on an airplane. Further investigation discovered his username, NicholasB77, was the host of a podcast where he interviewed another “boy lover” about their sexual attraction to young children. We have the clips.
Kaya Orsan joins us to talk about a confusing podcast called Gender Spiral. The hosts interview Da’Shaun L. Harrison about “body fascism.” Apparently, being flat and black is not allowed under fascist regimes, and fat people in the US are currently experiencing this. Cardiff Electric made a fantastic short video using real audio from Chad Zumock. Cringe of the Week is the Isotopes’ 9/11 jokes. Opie is super stoked about the president promising everyone $5k if Republicans win the mid-terms and can’t stop doing what he calls “the dick dance.” The chat is trolling Opie and Ron but Opie has it up as an overlay now. Jerry Banfield went live and his honesty is refreshing. Jerry explains how he’s been able to live off of debt his entire life and continue to qualify for loans. item.title: Ep760 - David Lee Roth, Jerry Banfield, Opie, Kevin Brennan, Aaron Imholte
item.description:
This week we’re rediscovering all the things we love and hate about David Lee Roth. He’s posting some bizarre videos where he rambles about chili dogs and how cool he used to be. This story doesn’t seem plausible but then I wasn’t a giant rock star in 1982 so who knows?
It’s Whitney Cummings’ birthday “week.” Aaron Imholte reaches a new low by doxxing his ex-wife April’s new job and pretending he doesn’t want her to get harassed. Adam Busch has been trying to address Kevin Brennan’s slanderous accusations but KB is proving to be a coward. Unfortunately for him, everyone can see right through it. Even his devotees. Quadfather on BYB finally gets something right. But only one thing. Jerry Banfield had a date with a woman who hated his guts. And probably rightfully so, although they both seem terrible. The best part is Jerry telling her how dumb she is and then recording two vlogs reiterating it. Opie had Ron the Waiter and Erik Marino on the show. Opie gets a point for reprimanding Ron but loses all credibility for laughing at Erik’s dumb callbacks and non-jokes. Megan and Annie join the show for a round of “Is It Gay?”, the “Opie or Burr” game, Spotify comments, reviews, and your voicemails.

item.title: Ep759 - Friends Keep Secrets, Jerry Banfield, Opie, Artie Fletcher
item.description:
This week we’re checking out a podcast hosted by huge celebrities - Benny Blanco and Lil Dicky (Dave Burd). Dave’s wife Kristin Batalucco is also there for some reason. They had notorious drug addict Hunter Biden on the show and boy is it a hoot. Especially when Hunter shows his paintings and unironically says they’re good. 
Jodie B. stops by to watch the final seven minutes of Artie Fletcher’s 2012 standup special. The camera man walks up on stage and we get to see what this room looks like and the girl that Artie’s been hitting on the entire set. Jerry Banfield is fed up with promoting ICP and making no money from it, so he shows the world just how much integrity and credibility he actually has. We get the watch the final six minutes of the unlisted video sent to the queen and wow! What a payoff! Opie had Ron and Tony on his FU Friday and these two guys are starting to really dislike each other. They’re both yelling about politics and Opie just lets this happen. We finish the show with Aaron Imholte’s gay thoughts, the Internet News, and your voicemails.

item.title: Ep758 - Jerry's Unlisted Queen Video!! Opie & Ron, MLC, Bert Kreischer
item.description:
After a quick look at how bad terrestrial radio is in 2026, we get an update on Bert Kreischer. Bert has cut his drinking down drastically and is having a really hard time getting back to being the raging alcoholic he used to be. He really misses being irresponsible. Those were the days.
Adam Busch brings in the Cringe of the Week and we can’t figure out what Bryan Callen is talking about. Kevin Brennan is afraid of Adam Busch. He lashes out at Adam and accuses him of all sorts of heinous crimes but won’t dare actually talk to him. He’s also mad that Geno Bisconte had a good week. Kevin is hoping his viewers will destroy any potential opportunities that might be coming Geno’s way. Opie is still at war with Howard Stern. The funny part is, Howard doesn’t know about this rivalry and yet he’s still beating Opie on every level. And speaking of one-sided rivalries, Ron the Waiter is going after Jim Norton and it’s pathetic. Jerry put the unlisted video he sent to the girl he fell in love with up for sale. $2000 was the price. Thanks to @JerryBanfieldgaming we get to watch it and boy is it brutal! He thought he could convince her she liked him? And this guy runs a dating advice channel?? That's why we love Jerry Banfield! Megan and Annie join the program to play “Is It Gay?” and “Opie or Burr.” We finish with comments and your voicemails.
WATP candy available now: https://www.leiselandfriendsgourmet.com/

item.title: Ep757 - Better Half with Stas & Vic, Opie, Jerry Banfield, Artie Fletcher
item.itunes:title: Better Half with Stas & Vic, Opie, Jerry Banfield, Artie Fletcher
item.itunes:author: WhoAreThese.com
item.content:encoded:
This week we’re checking in on an influencer named Stas who does a podcast with her ugly friend Vic. Stas happens to be BFFs with Kylie Jenner and when the three of them get together it’s a whole lot of stupid. Kylie is possibly the worst cat owner in the world. 

Vinnie Paulino joins the show to watch KarmicX sing a Ween song he doesn’t know for the Cringe of the Week segment. We have the bodycam footage from Stuttering John’s house back in April. He called the cops when a DoorDasher rang the doorbell too many times. ShizoSean joins the show to tell us about banging Mersh’s ex-girlfriend IceDanc3r and his exploits at Steel Toe’s anniversary show, Chrissie Mayr’s content hotel, and Vito Gesualdi’s house. We watch a new DVD comedy special of Artie Fletcher from 2004. His set at Coconuts in St. Pete Beach reminds Vinnie of the worst time in his life. Jerry Banfield is doing a victory lap because his business made almost $400 in one day. He’s literally rubbing it in the faces of the haters while explaining that he’s taking cash advances from credit cards to pay his rent. Opie has a big FU Friday with all three of his friends. Erik Marino is somehow the least funny try-hard on a show that includes Ron the Waiter. Trump renaming Lake Ontario has broken his brain so he only has one joke the entire stream. Tony P. seems to be losing his patience with these idiots. We finish up with Internet News and your voicemails.

item.title: Ep756 - Bill Burr, Kevin Brennan, Opie & Tony P, Jerry Banfield, Chad Zumock
item.description:
We start with Mersh from ROTC getting his ex-girlfriend fired from her job. He’s not proud of it… or is he? Bill Burr cohosted the Guitar Center Drum-off so you know what that means, Bill is gonna give us his hot takes on percussion music theory. Bob diddity bop blopt bop bop! There’s also talk about space and quiet. Bill must be a GREAT drummer.
On Cringe of the Week we have a music edition featuring David Lee Roth strumming, Corey Feldman rehearsing, and Richard Marx demanding. Neal Brennan was on Howie Mandel’s podcast and he talked about Kevin Brennan even though Neal wanted nothing to do with it. KB got drunk on MLC and proved that his only real enemy is his successful younger brother. Chad Zumock proves he doesn’t understand why he doesn’t like the “Get Along Gang.” Jerry Banfield thinks he’s killing it on the dating apps until one day later when he admits it’s wrecking him. He can’t let go of the Queen. It would be sad if it weren’t so hilarious! Opie called Tony P out for using wifi as his excuse for not coming on Opie Unfiltered’s F U Friday. Now he has to get reprimanded for not being totally forthcoming with Opie. Remember: Opie pays him zero dollars and zero cents. Megan and Annie join us for another round of “Is It Gay?” and the “Opie or Burr” game. We finish with comments, reviews, and your voicemails.

item.title: Ep754 - Tony Michaels Rebrand, Stuttering John, Opie Unfiltered, Jerry Banfield
item.description:
Whitney Cummings decided to scrap an entire episode and then she scrambled to record a new one that no one was prepared for. What could she have possibly said about Perez Hilton? Tony Michaels has decided to completely change his show format. The problem is, he’s still the host and he is endlessly unlikeable. 
Adam Busch revisited Stuttering John’s Beer on the Balcony featuring David Feldman. It’s incredible to watch John’s guest quickly realize that John has a childlike understanding of politics and the world and he can’t stop trashing everyone he’s ever worked with. David tries to help him but StutJo can’t be fixed. Jerry Banfield contemplates selling us the 16 minute unlisted video he sent to his queen to win her back. You won’t believe who he asked for advice on what to do. Opie can't wait to milk the attention he finally got from Anthony Cumia after his cohost Ron the Waiter made fun of the Anthony and Jim Show. The problem is, Ron and Opie have no idea how to respond in a way that doesn't prove everything Anthony said is 100% accurate. Epic fail! Megan joins the show to play “Is It Gay?” and Simon’s “Opie or Burr” game. We catch up on the Internet News and finish up with your voicemails.

item.title: Ep753 - Joe Cronin Show, Jerry Banfield, Opie vs. Anthony, Zman
item.description:
Joe Cronin hosts a wrestling show that perhaps at one time was popular. That’s definitely not the case anymore. He seems to hate it. The specific episode we chose to review is a definite red flag. He probably needs someone who loves him (or just kinda likes him) to step in and help. 
Jim from Jim and Them had an amazing accomplishment recently. He and his cohost were able to infiltrate (purchase tickets for) Corey Feldman’s 55th birthday party. Corey’s band performed (of course). Jerry Banfield continues to struggle with his current existence. He LOVES dating girls but he also wants to settle down and have children ASAP. People try to help him but he refuses all common sense advice because, this just in, he might be crazy. Howard Stern’s band The Losers played King Crimson. Chad Zumock bails on a debate with Rocco about the business of stand up comedy and makes up a horrible excuse for it. He scared! Anthony Cumia slaps back at Ron the Waiter after Ron’s horrible impression of Ant and Ron’s uneducated assessment of the Anthony and Jim Show. Ron is so out of his league it’s hilarious. Anthony took a lie detector on Legion of Skanks and it turned into an “Opie sucks” chant from the audience. Opie’s FU Friday episode is full of unfunny references for 40 years ago that are both lazy and depressing. We finish with your voicemails.
Subscribe to Jim’s channel (it’s really good): https://www.youtube.com/@JimandThemShow

item.title: Ep752 - Opie Unfiltered, Jerry Banfield, Kevin Brennan, Aaron Imholte, Whitney Cummings
item.description:
We start with Mario Bosco appearing in front of 18,000 fans on Kill Tony. He may not be very funny but he actually does have the misguided confidence he’s known for. Chad Zumock outed Aaron Imholte for getting too drunk at the Steel Toe anniversary event and poor Aaron could not figure out how to spin it.
After we listen to Stuttering John’s isolated vocal tracks as our Cringe of the Week segment, we check in on Whitney Cummings who can’t improvise her way out of a thing that someone would need to improvise their way out of. Kevin Christy, her cohost, has a joke that bombs spectacularly! Kevin Brennan is angry and streaming 24/7 at this point. He gets mad watching his brother interview Craig Ferguson but then feels better when his chat suggests he could take Dave Smith’s spot on Legion of Skanks. He convinces himself he’s basically been offered the position which is soothing to the senile old fool. Jerry Banfield has completed the transformation from lovable loser to evil supervillain. He wants to get laid really badly and so he has become a nuisance to every woman who enters into his orbit. Opie finally commented on the Anthony and Jim Show and boy is he butthurt! Wow!! He lashes out at Jim Norton who hasn't said anything about Opie in many, many years! Megan and Annie join us for a round of “Is It Gay?” and Simon’s “Opie or Burr” games. We finish with your voicemails.

item.title: Ep751 - Kinky Katie's World, Topic Time, Jerry Banfield, Opie, Stephanie Brie
item.description:
Kinky Katie is a never-was porn actress who thinks she's coherent enough to host a podcast about fetishes. As gross as her and her cohost are when it comes to sex, nothing they say is interesting or titillating.
Mean Doug joins us to prove this show will keep any guy's penis soft for hours. Jerry Banfield almost texted "the queen" but fortunately ChatGPT told him not to. We get a boots on the ground update on Chad Zumock in Detroit. Harrison Young had a "model" on Topic Time and it couldn't be more awkward and hilarious. Doug brings Stephanie Brie to show us what's really grinding "her" gears this week. It will surprise you (as it did me). Opie has changed the name of his show and explains why to his guest Scott Ferrall. Opie found his guy! Another delusional has-been thinks he's killing it with a big audience. Scott Ferrall doesn't realize his claims are easy to fact check and completely insane!
Doug's show - https://whosrightpodcast.com/

item.title: Ep750 - Lifeline w/Chris D'Elia, Kevin Brennan, Joe Matarese, Jerry Banfield, Opie
item.description:
This week we start by checking in on Joe Matarese’s Road Back to Philly. This show has turned into a heavily medicated hasbeen having boring conversations about the weather with a dullard. Danny can’t spit out a single question and Joe pretends it’s a normal back and forth.
Adam has been documenting the mental decline of Kevin Brennan for a few weeks now. Everything Kevin says is a lie. Everything that makes him a winner is suddenly a loss when it applies to others. Ethan Ralph has zero understanding of how Stuttering John is doing. Jerry Banfield takes us through his dating profile with full explanations and why he picked out each picture and how he chose his words for his bio. Spoiler: ChatGPT told him what to do. And he thinks this is his authentic self. Megan and Annie hop on early for a round of “Is It Gay?” and then we check in quickly on Aaron Imholte with his most anti-semitic rant yet. Artie Fletcher finally found a way to shut us up. Chris D’Elia and his brother don’t give a single f*ck about their audience on Lifeline and actively spit in their faces. I’ve literally never seen a show more phoned in and boring than this one. Opie saw Kevin Hart’s movie and can’t stop complaining about how much he hated it. When the chat calls him out for not being a feminist he gets enraged and comes back with an extremely nonsensical response. We finish up with recent reviews and your voicemails.
Adam is opening for Roger Daltrey: https://www.yaamava.com/entertainment/roger-daltrey
Tickets to see us live in Detroit: http://watplive.com/

This week we start by checking in on Joe Matarese’s Road Back to Philly. This show has turned into a heavily medicated hasbeen having boring conversations about the weather with a dullard. Danny can’t spit out a single question and Joe pretends it’s a normal back and forth.

Adam has been documenting the mental decline of Kevin Brennan for a few weeks now. Everything Kevin says is a lie. Everything that makes him a winner is suddenly a loss when it applies to others. Ethan Ralph has zero understanding of how Stuttering John is doing. Jerry Banfield takes us through his dating profile with full explanations and why he picked out each picture and how he chose his words for his bio. Spoiler: ChatGPT told him what to do. And he thinks this is his authentic self. Megan and Annie hop on early for a round of “Is It Gay?” and then we check in quickly on Aaron Imholte with his most anti-semitic rant yet. Artie Fletcher finally found a way to shut us up. Chris D’Elia and his brother don’t give a single f*ck about their audience on Lifeline and actively spit in their faces. I’ve literally never seen a show more phoned in and boring than this one. Opie saw Kevin Hart’s movie and can’t stop complaining about how much he hated it. When the chat calls him out for not being a feminist he gets enraged and comes back with an extremely nonsensical response. We finish up with recent reviews and your voicemails.

item.title: Ep749 - Scatpodcast by Dirty Gary, Opie Radio, Jerry Banfield, Artie Fletcher
item.description:
For everyone who’s been asking us to get back to old school episodes of WATP, careful what you wish for. We meet Dirty Gary, a gay man who is really into scat, aka poopy. Wait until you hear what his guest has been up to. I didn’t realize I could be shocked by a podcast in 2026, but here we are.
Tab Birt joins us in studio and Nice Doug is also on to share listener questions that will make you blush. Cringe of the Week is the Regz with Luis J Gomez getting Robert Kelly to tickle him. Chad Zumock lied about Nikki Glaser donating $500 and he is handling it the worst way possible. Artie Fletcher sets up premises that never pay off. It’s like he’s not listening to himself. Jerry Banfield tells us way too much about his personal life and I can’t get enough! He sent a 16 minute video to the woman he has a crush on and tells us every embarrassing thing he said in it. Oh, and he changes his business model again. Opie had a riveting FU Friday with Tony and Ron full of hot takes on Jewish food, Benjamin Franklin, and Yoko Ono’s butt. The best part was when they talked about burying their pets. What a fun show! We finish up with Internet News and your voicemails.

item.title: Ep748 - Bill Burr, Opie Radio, Jerry Banfield, Artie Fletcher, MLC, Chad Zumock
item.itunes:title: Bill Burr, Opie Radio, Jerry Banfield, Artie Fletcher, MLC, Chad Zumock
item.itunes:author: WhoAreThese.com
item.content:encoded:
Today we start with the revelation that Nikki Glaser did not send Chad $500 for his special. Shocking I know! Cardiff did some great investigating and proved that once again Chad has made up a lie that wouldn’t have made him look good even if it were true. 

Artie Fletcher’s standup set is getting more and more bizarre. Crowd work for your DVD special isn’t a good idea but local references to cater to the audience in front of you might be even worse. KC Day was a good sport putting together the Trek Off for Vinnie Paulino’s consequence and he made a heart warming tribute song for us. Jerry Banfield made every mistake possible with the love of his life and he’s finally ready to talk about where it all went wrong. Unfortunately he learned to stop giving us all of the details on his vlog. Good takeaway but not good for WATP. Kevin Brennan did one of the craziest things I’ve ever seen - he watched Adam Busch acting on a sitcom with Jon Lovitz, Danny Trejo, Cheri Oteri, etc. and decided that it proves Adam didn’t get paid and that he’s a failed actor. Bill Burr had Julian Casablancas, the lead singer from the Strokes on his show and he couldn’t be been less prepared. It’s awkward and embarrassing. Opie had Tony P cohost with him on Monday morning and shuts down any chance Tony had to promote his comedy. When Ron joins on Tuesday he tries once again to hit the goal and the reason he needs $100 this time is insane! Megan and Annie join us for a round of “Is It Gay?” and “Opie or Burr.” We get caught up on Spotify comments, reviews, and your voicemails. 

Adam is opening for Roger Daltrey: https://www.yaamava.com/entertainment/roger-daltrey

item.title: Ep747 - Misery Loves Company, Scorch, Opie, Artie Fletcher, Jerry Banfield
item.description:
Kevin Brennan’s mental illness is on full display as he screams at Flimsy Greenberg for creating a dashboard. Chad Zumock calls into Misery Loves Company to brag about asking successful comics to fund his new special. For some reason life is going well for both Kevin and Chad because Pat Dixon doesn’t own a car. It makes sense as long as you don’t think about it.
Vinnie Paulino joins the show to check in on Scorch with his cohost B.O.B. from 95X. Every story Scorch tells is based on being poor. Artie Fletcher’s stand up special includes anecdotes about employees at the comedy club and people in the audience he knows. Why would that be on a comedy DVD? Jerry Banfield has come up with yet another new business model. After an update on the Christian woman he’s completely fallen in love with, he explains a new service he thinks he’s going to charge $20,000 for. Opie’s new friend Erik Marino is somehow less funny than Ron, Tony, and Opie. Opie’s on fire because he had to poop a lot after eating sugar-free ice cream. We finish up with Internet News and your voicemails.
The Creep Off: https://thecreepoff.com/

item.title: Ep746 - Kevin Brennan is Mental! Jerry Banfield, Opie Radio, Chad Zumock, Bryan Callen
item.description:
We start off with Chad Zumock issuing a challenge to Pat Dixon and he includes “anywhere, anytime.” Pat immediately accepts the challenge, calling Chad’s bluff, and makes the Zman look extremely foolish. Fortunately for Chad, some super famous and successful comics donated to his GoFundMe. Which I totally believe.
I received the sad news that John C Dvorak passed away this week. We play a couple of clips from his show, No Agenda, about what a prick Richard Marx is/was. Christian Bladt makes our “Cringe of the Week.” Artie Fletcher does some of the most hack jokes about TV commercials and manscaping you’ll ever hear. We check out Bryan Callen getting embarrassed on Jesse Lee Peterson’s show. Jerry Banfield has been destroyed by the woman he met 9 days ago. Who could have seen that coming?  Fortunately, he also found Jesus, which is convenient because this chick is super into Jesus. Kevin Brennan needs everything outside of Misery Loves Company to be a failure. Any success in entertainment is somehow a slight at Kevin. What are we talking about? Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey, Adam Busch's acting career, and Sam Morril's stand up career. I'm not kidding, for real!! Kevin Brennan is mentally ill. Opie is getting ghosted by celebrities and it’s really shaking his confidence. Ron claims he’ll continue to be Opie’s friend even after Ron becomes famous. Opie doesn’t care. Megan and Annie join us for rounds of “Is It Gay?” and “Opie or Burr.” Megan has some recent Spotify comments, Annie reads some new reviews, and we finish with your voicemails.

item.title: Ep745 - What's Our Podcast?, Opie Radio, Jerry Banfield, Cumia on BYB
item.itunes:title: What's Our Podcast?, Opie Radio, Jerry Banfield, Cumia on BYB
item.itunes:author: WhoAreThese.com
item.content:encoded:
This week we’re checking in on Kyle Mooney and Beck Bennett, two SNL alums who are maybe the most forgettable cast members ever. Kyle Mooney is especially terrible and he proves it on this podcast that relies on schtick and nonsense. 

Trucker Andy joins us to discuss where on the doll Kyle touched him. Jerry Banfield has once again fallen in love. Oh no. I have a feeling this won’t end well. Jerry is once again falling in love immediately. If this woman watches this stream she is going to file a restraining order. Anthony Cumia went on Quadfather’s show, BYB Podcast. Even though Ava was on, Ant did a great job of explaining why Chad Zumock will definitely steal the money he was given for his GoFundMe. Opie had another F U Friday with Ron and Tony. Opie is getting more confident with these zilches. He’s trying out material. Somehow, he’s still the least funny guy. We finish with Internet News and your voicemails.

item.title: Ep744 - Kathy Griffin, Artie Fletcher, Opie Radio, Jerry Banfield, Aaron Imholte, MLC
item.description:
This week we’re checking in on Kathy Griffin who actually has a weekly video podcast. Of all the people who you’d think would have an audio-only show, Kathy’s on the top of the list. She is still fighting a battle against Donald Trump that our president is unaware is happening. She was on broadway performing in some play that totally bombed and got to take a private jet back to LA with Rosie O’Donnell. If I could sum this up in one word it would be “insufferable.”
A listener mailed in Artie Fletcher’s stand up “special” on DVD. Artie is able to squeeze so many hack bits in it’s almost impressive. Adam Busch has a supercut that really proves Kevin Brennan has morphed into a bitter hasbeen who is almost identical to Stuttering John. Jerry Banfield is critical of our critiques. Hopefully he listens to us this time because he’s about to make the same mistake that put him $600k in debt in the past. Opie is trying the reverse psychology beg that got him to his goal last week. The problem is, there just aren’t enough people watching to make this work. Steel Toe is trying to turn not allowing me on his show into a win. No one is buying it because it doesn’t make any sense. Megan joins us for another Aaron Imholte “Gay Thoughts,” a round of “Is It Gay?” and Simon’s “Opie or Burr” game. We finish with Spotify comments and your voicemails.

item.title: Ep743 - Steel Toe, Kevin Brennan, Chad Zumock, Opie Radio
item.description:
This episode is a little bit different as we combine This Little Piggy and WATP. Yesterday I went on Chad Zumock’s show with Bob Levy and by most accounts, it didn’t go well for Chad. We start by seeing how Kevin Brennan is dealing with his guy showing up unprepared and getting embarrassed. Chad seems to think it went fine. Wild!
Pat Dixon and Moody both join the show as we do a deep dive into Steel Toe’s week, starting with his retarded assessment of my debate with Chad. Aaron won’t let me come on his show and debate him which is somehow a win for the Toe? We also watch him miss goals by a lot and Moody breaks the news of a brand new restraining order against him from Kayla Rekieta. Yikes! Chip Chipperson breaks character to laugh with Jim Florentine about Artie Fletcher. Opie has a new friend, Be A Man, who is a total cornball. But don’t worry, Opie has a crazy story about taking his dog out to poop in the middle of the night. He’s fired up about it. We finish with your voicemails.
Check out Pat Dixon and subscribe - https://www.youtube.com/@pdixon

item.itunes:author: WhoAreThese.com
item.itunes:summary:
This episode is a little bit different as we combine This Little Piggy and WATP. Yesterday I went on Chad Zumock’s show with Bob Levy and by most accounts, it didn’t go well for Chad. We start by seeing how Kevin Brennan is dealing with his guy showing up unprepared and getting embarrassed. Chad seems to think it went fine. Wild!
Pat Dixon and Moody both join the show as we do a deep dive into Steel Toe’s week, starting with his retarded assessment of my debate with Chad. Aaron won’t let me come on his show and debate him which is somehow a win for the Toe? We also watch him miss goals by a lot and Moody breaks the news of a brand new restraining order against him from Kayla Rekieta. Yikes! But don’t worry, Opie has a crazy story about taking his dog out to poop in the middle of the night. He’s fired up about it. We finish with your voicemails.

item.title: Ep742 - Scorch is BACK, Opie & Ron, Chad Zumock, Jerry Banfield, Gallagher
item.description:
Scorch is so awkward interviewing women. He seems like a guy with no game trying to get laid. But he also can’t get away from his old, terrible radio bits as he treats us to a round of Scorch’s Psychotic 6.
Cringe of the Week features Elijah Schaffer fighting with his producer while being belligerent on his own show. Myster Magenta has a great new song parody. Chad Zumock reluctantly drops the copyright strike against Patrick Melton. He then deals with moderator drama and couldn’t make it less interesting. The Portcast with Ron Bennington is extremely compelling. We find out why Gallagher had to move in with Artie Fletcher’s mom. Jerry Banfield was manically depressed that a woman doesn’t like him the way he likes her, so he comforted himself with hours of communicating with AI. He then completely changed his business model once again and it just keeps getting worse. Opie actually figured out a way to start making money. He’s using reverse psychology and it’s actually effective! Ron is continuing to piss me off with his lack of gratitude. Megan and Annie join the show to play Megan’s “Is It Gay?” and Simon’s “Opie or Burr” games. We finish with comments, reviews, and voicemails.

item.title: Ep741 - Joe Rogan w/Tommy Lee, Opie Radio, Chad Zumock, Jerry Banfield, MLC
item.description:
This week we’re checking in on Joe Rogan because he had Tommy Lee on his show. Tommy is a trip. Dude still talks like it’s 1983 and it somehow gets Joe to revert to his level. They both have deep philosophical thoughts you could only hear in a freshman dorm room.
Jen from the Jingles Department joins us to chat about Chad Zumock crying over his GoFundMe hitting the goal. Uh oh, now he has to make a comedy special. Emphasis on the word “special.” Kevin Brennan is once again wrong about everything. But at least we learn that he’s not trying to put on a funny show. Jerry Banfield has given up on one of his goals but it’s okay because it’s going to give him time to put out way more crap. Opie has the entire Friday gang on - Ron Berman, Tony P, and Erik Marino. They never stop making fun of Ron’s shirt and it never gets old. We finish with Net News and voicemails.

item.title: Ep740 - Kevin Spacey on Bill Maher, Opie Radio, Chad Zumock, Jerry Banfield
item.description:
Kevin Spacey was a guest on Club Random with Bill Maher this week. This was an important interview that Bill showed up completely unprepared for. He did no homework and got very high before the interview. It’s also not surprising that Bill considers himself an ally but actually comes off as a little homophobic. Wait until you find out what Kevin Spacey has been doing for a living for the past few years.
Darren Paltrowitz and Lucy Tightbox both join us to learn that the only thing Kevin is guilty of is loving too much. Ethan Ralph thought he ended his show and we got to see him use his hands to eat bagged tuna, mayo, and Doritos like a primate. Chad Zumock struck Patrick Melton’s channel even though Patrick didn’t do anything that Chad hasn’t done a hundred times. The way he justifies it is insane! Jerry Banfield is getting the worst business advice possible from AI and he’s convinced it’s the solution to all of his problems. Opie is obviously watching all of the shows and is afraid of the Dabbleverse. He should really just embrace it. It's crazy that he thinks the only way to make money podcasting is to beg his small audience for donations. Maybe his AI assistant told him that? We play another round of “Is It Gay?” and the Opie or Burr game with Megan and Annie. We finish up with your voicemails.

item.title: Ep739 - HTBITY w/Corey Feldman, Artie Fletcher, Joe Matarese, Jerry Banfield, Hawk Tuah
item.description:
This week we’re excited that crazy Hollywood reject Jamie Kennedy interviewed crazier Hollywood reject Corey Feldman. They get into a heated argument about which pedophiles are worse - Hollywood vs Jeffrey Epstein vs Pizzagate. The best part is when Corey explains that Jim and Them are being paid to make fun of him and that that should be against the law.
Christian Bladt joins the show to present Artie Fletcher calling into to Mike Calta’s show. Mike called Artie out on his BS immediately and he never let off the gas, which is brilliant! Jerry Banfield apparently took a hit off a joint and started talking about how time is just a social construct, man! He’s so much dumber than he’ll ever know. Hawk Tuah is still making videos that no one could possibly care about. Please tell me she’s updating her resume. Joe Matarese keeps changing the format of his “Road Back to Philly” podcast. Now he’s comparing Philadelphia to Dan’s home state of Utah. What a show! We finish up with Internet News and your voicemails.

item.title: Ep738 - Opie’s Breakthough, Brendan Schaub, Aaron Imholte, StutJo, Chad Zumock, Jerry Banfield
item.description:
We start off discussing Chad Zumock’s GoFundMe. The Zman wants to film a comedy special and he needs you to help his struggling comedy career. The way Chad is asking for money, with an AI written nonsensical explanation of why this is important for independent creators, is hilariously bad even for Chad.
Brendan Schaub has completely changed his schedule and at the same time, his career. He’s given up on podcasting and now just wants people to pay him to answer questions. Jerry Banfield thinks he was a millionaire twice and that he’ll be a millionaire again. None of that is true. Stuttering John recorded another Cameo and he’s looking rough! We revisit Howard Stern getting to the bottom of the Stuttering John and Friends tour that was extremely profitable for one guy, John Melendez. Opie finally recognizes his show is the kind of mindless drivel he and the boys mocked mercilessly during Jocktober segments. Tony can only respond by asking if he needs a hug. Why is Ron the Waiter saying no one is donating to his Venmo? Where is the money going?? Aaron Imholte can’t handle the pressure of the goal and he takes out his anger and frustration on one of his loyal donators. Megan and Annie join for a round of “Is It Gay?” (Mersh themed) and the Opie or Burr game. We finish with comments, reviews, and voicemails.

item.title: Ep737 - Johnny Krutches, Opie Radio, StutJo, Artie Fletcher, Jerry Banfield
item.description:
This week we’re checking out Johnny Krutches’ show, The Game Over Podcast. Steel Toe’s cohost couldn’t be more boring or depressing. He’s learned from Aaron Imholte that it’s important to raise money for a goal, even though he literally has dozens of viewers.
Jodie B and Cardiff Electric both join us to play a Johnny version of “Is It Gay?” Jodie checks in on Jiamah, the black queer Christian, who has a brand new business venture. Is Jerry Banfield her mentor? Speaking of Jerry, he’s talking about why spending $10k on dating so far this year was a great investment, even though it hasn’t translated to a single relationship. Opie is gaslighting his audience and cohosts to think that O&A was toxic because of Anthony and Jim. WHAT?!?!? That's crazy, even for delusional Opie!! item.title: Ep736 - Jerry Banfield, Opie & Ron, Chad Zumock, Whitney Cummings
item.description:
Jerry Banfield got some amazing news and he is riding high! After creating the Jerry Banfield Family on skool.com and updating his website with AI, all he needed was one more thing to happen… paying customers. I’m happy to report he’s now half way to having paying customers.
Howard Stern recently performed a stellar version of “the Wheels on the Bus” for his grandchildren and lucky for us he recreates the concert on his show. Steel Toe can’t figure out what to do with me but he can’t get me out of his head. James Cox joins the show from England to discuss the latest with Opie and Ron. Finally we get a peak at Ron the Waiter’s Venmo… or do we? This Venmo launch is a debacle and so is Opie’s wifi issues. Chad Zumock teamed up with Clearwater Chad so that the Zman could get a feel for what it’s like to have a yes man and be the more intelligent guy on a show for once. Whitney Cummings is STILL trying to justify her impossible views to comments ratio on YouTube. For some reason it’s better to censor your critics than to purchase views. Meanwhile, she’s doing both. But stick around for crazy talk about hot dog toppings. Megan and Annie join us for a Dabbleverse edition of “Is It Gay?” and the 25th installment of the Opie or Burr game from Simon. We finish off with Spotify comments, a review, and your voicemails.
Check out James Cox’s channel: https://www.youtube.com/@coxysmakingvideos
Support us, get bonus episodes, and watch live every Saturday and Wednesday:

item.title: Ep735 - Nerd Talk Podcast, Opie Radio, Jerry Banfield, Artie & Gallagher
item.description:
This week we’re introduced to ShonnyDman, a nerd who enjoys Marvel, DC…. the list goes on. He’s especially talented at interviewing cosplay models who have nothing going on in their lives. And wait until he tries to tell us about an animated series he watched months ago and has mostly forgotten. Riveting!
Doug from Good Times Great Movies joins the show to explain that Partyhardycosplay might be a moron. Gallagher and Artie Fletcher were in Wyoming promoting their comedy show on Z94 FM. Watching Gallagher lecture Artie for being terrible on the radio is way funnier than whatever they do on stage. Jerry Banfield is desperate for companionship and thinks that going out on lots of dates but never getting to date number 2 is actually a triumph! Especially because he’s spent $10k on dating advice already this year. Opie has decided to add another anchor to his show in the form of Erik Marino. This guy is a DUD!! In other words, he fits right in. We finish things up with Internet News and your voicemails.
Check out Doug’s channel: https://www.youtube.com/@GoodTimesGreatMovies

item.title: Ep734 - Just Trish, Stuttering John, Steel Toe, Opie Radio, MLC w/Dave Landau
item.description:
The great Dave Landau joins the show and we introduce him to Trisha Paytas. Somehow Dave has gone the last 14 years without ever getting exposed to this slob. There’s a rumor that her former podcasting partner Colleen Ballinger aka Miranda Sings may have another documentary made about her inappropriate communications with underage fans.
One of those underage fans who outed Colleen is Adam McIntyre who’s reporting on the Ethan Klein vs. Denims copyright lawsuit. H3 took a big hit after the judge came out with a tentative ruling that could set a positive precedent for fair use. Aaron from Steel Toe had a major blow-up with his cohost Johnny. But don’t worry, Aaron declares that he handled it perfectly and was even proud of himself for how he handled it. Kevin Brennan continues to fight a war that no one started against Adam Busch. Even KB’s chat realizes he’s lying and has no idea what he’s talking about. KB’s show failed because an HBO exec was fired for domestic abuse? Right. Sure. Part 2 of Stuttering John with Kirk Fox is even more spectacular as John cannot read the room and instead wants to ask him about celebrities he’s had intercourse with. Opie gets triggered again by speculation about getting kicked out of Gebhard's and loses it on Kevin Brennan. Gregg is finding new and diabolical ways to keep Ron from giving out his Venmo and making money while Opie asks for donations through his new QR code. Megan and Annie join us for a round of “Is It Gay?” and “Opie or Burr.” We finish with Spotify comments, reviews, and your voicemails.
Watch this episode here: https://youtube.com/live/DWo5qyaMsQ4
Dave Landau’s dates and more - https://davelandau.com/

item.title: Ep733 - FU Friday, Joe Matarese, Artie Fletcher, Jerry Banfield
item.description:
Joe Matarese just dropped episode 3 of his new show about forcing his wife to move to Philadelphia. In this episode we’re helping Joe figure out where he’s going to go on vacation. And then he announces that he’s going to completely change the show format. Thank God Dan is there to help him focus a little bit.
Jim from Jim and Them joins the show and gives Joe a call to provide some feedback on his podcast. Sam Tripoli got into a whole discussion about the Dabbleverse and gets most of it right. Opie is raising money for his dental bill and apparently Kevin Brennan has some questions about it. As soon as Opie finds out that KB is paying attention he’s triggered and it bothers him for the entire stream. Jerry Banfield explains that the secret to happiness is to do everything wrong in life and pretend everything is great. Delusion = contentment. Artie Fletcher, a huge celebrity and amazing talent, somehow ended up on Alive and Kickin’ with Leesa Marie Benz. It turns out, this is exactly where he belongs because he's a lying liar! We finish up with Internet News and your voicemails.
Jim and Them - https://www.youtube.com/@JimandThemShow

item.title: Ep732 - The Quartering, MLC v Busch, StutJo, Opie, Andrew Santino
item.description:
Jeremy Hambly, host of the Quartering, has completely lost control of his show and his life. He's falling into every LOLcow trap. He's letting the chat dictate his content, he's combative, and arguing with individuals who are trolling him. This is not going to end well.
Whitney Cummings truly believes that she knows what she’s talking about. Lucy Tightbox joins the show to discuss Andrew Santino’s show, Whisky Ginger, when he had a handicapable comedian on, Fiona Cauley, and we can’t tell which person sucks more. Kevin Brennan called out Adam Busch who just tried to pay the guy a compliment when Adam was cast as Kevin’s brother on his defunct HBO sitcom. Adam responds to KB’s nonsense. Stuttering John booked Kirk Fox on Stephanie Miller’s show and Kirk actively despises John. John gets humiliated and it’s awesome! Opie spends time with Ron the Waiter and Tony P working out issues that he’s dealing with in therapy. We also learn about the exciting conclusion of Opie’s curbside mattress in the Hamptons. Annie and Megan join the show for a round of “Is It Gay?” and the “Opie or Burr” game by Simon from the Worst Ever Podcast. We finish up with comments, reviews, and your voicemails.
Watch this episode here: https://youtube.com/live/744JlST-YyA
Lucy’s channel: https://www.youtube.com/@OnceOverwithCayley

item.title: Ep731 - Fierce Fatty revisited, Opie, Jerry Banfield Returns
item.description:
We’re revisiting Vinny Welsby, aka the Fierce Fatty, who just put out a video highlighting the 49 benefits of being fat. The amount of cope is hilarious including fat people can hide their pregnancy and the sex is great because you rub your bellies together.
Trucker Andy is in studio to laugh about how being fat comes in real handy when you’re playing tug of war. On Cringe of the Week, Schmuel Buckman joins Hughezy’s show and it does not go well for the first couple of minutes. Scorch might have a new gig! Jerry Banfield is back, and he’s back to being Jerry Banfield! He’s got himself in a whole bunch of debt and is ready to bury himself as deep as he can while trying to become an internet celebrity again. We check out a classic moment on the Howard Stern Show when Gary and John have a fight on air. It seems John never picked up on the fact that Gary was his boss. Opie had an FU Friday / Superchat Friday and what he’s doing now is absolutely incredible - asking his viewers to donate to his PayPal to pay for his dental work. We finish up with Internet News and your voicemails.
Trucker Andy’s YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@AllApologiesPodcast

item.itunes:summary:
We’re revisiting Vinny Welsby, aka the Fierce Fatty, who just put out a video highlighting the 49 benefits of being fat. The amount of cope is hilarious including fat people can hide their pregnancy and the sex is great because you rub your bellies together.
Trucker Andy is in studio to laugh about how being fat comes in real handy when you’re playing tug of war. On Cringe of the Week, Schmuel Buckman joins Hughezy’s show and it does not go well for the first couple of minutes. Scorch might have a new gig! Jerry Banfield is back, and he’s back to being Jerry Banfield! He’s got himself in a whole bunch of debt and is ready to bury himself as deep as he can while trying to become an internet celebrity again. We check out a classic moment on the Howard Stern Show when Gary and John have a fight on air. It seems John never picked up on the fact that Gary was his boss. Opie had an FU Friday / Superchat Friday and what he’s doing now is absolutely incredible - asking his viewers to donate to his PayPal to pay for his dental work. We finish up with Internet News and your voicemails.
Trucker Andy’s YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@AllApologiesPodcast

item.title: Ep730 - Artie Fletcher's Roommate, Opie & Tony, Joe Matarese, Aaron Imholte
item.description:
This week we start off talking about Aaron Imholte who received a big donation that was a mistake. Aaron didn’t want to see that it was a mistake and his victory lap seems extremely foolish. He also got very worked up about reagandotcom in the free chat, wait for the reveal.
Vinnie Paulino joins the show to discuss Artie Fletcher’s stand up comedy. Artie's former roommate, Chuck Mignanelli, then hops on the show. Chuck explains that Artie is a pathological liar and has stories for days. Joe Matarese has a brand new podcast that’s about moving to Philly. But is it about moving to Philly? Opie had a big birthday weekend that was miserable. He tries to relate to a working class guy like Tony P but fails at connecting with a human who isn’t rich. Megan is back and her and Annie join the show for a round of “Is It Gay?” and the Opie or Burr game. We read recent reviews, comments, and listen to your voicemails.
Vinnie and I do a show together - https://thecreepoff.com/
Watch this episode here: https://youtube.com/live/WnHJncTLp-0

item.title: Ep729 - Mostly Dating
item.description:
Get ready to meet Carleigh Ferrante, a 30-something year old skeleton who gives out dating advice to people who apparently have no common sense, no self-esteem, and no dignity. She teaches losers how to flirt, what types of dates to go on, and even how to text. Finally, someone who can teach me how to text! Can there be some astrology mixed in? You betcha!!
Lucy Tightbox joins the show to watch a fake interview with Billy Corgan on legendary LA radio station KROQ. Stuttering John gets cockblocked on Stephanie Miller’s show by the guest’s mom. But that doesn’t stop him from asking embarrassing questions and using his children for LGBTQ clout. Opie had an amazing stream on Thursday morning that started with his depression over losing his only friend, then admitting to going back to therapy, and then addressing our show talking about him having a falling out with Matt at Gebhard’s. He also brings on a special guest who is supposedly a longtime friend but really she’s someone he definitely does not care about. We finish with Net News and your voicemails.
Subscribe to Lucy’s YouTube page if you dare: https://www.youtube.com/@OnceOverwithCayley

item.title: Ep728 - Take Your Shoes Off, Bryan Callen, Opie, Brendan Schaub, Stuttering John
item.description:
We start this week checking out Aaron Imholte’s latest cope session, this time about losing monetization on YouTube for violating their harassment policy. He has some ideas about how to make up for the lost income and they’re mostly “give me more money.”
The hosts of The Fighter and the Kid can’t even be bothered to show up for their own show. Bryan Callen is flailing. He went on Rick Glassman’s show and was totally humiliated as he wasn’t able to riff, improvise, or keep up. Opie went to Boston and couldn’t wait to tell Ron the Waiter how funny he was and show him the hilarious video he made about John Hancock’s grave. Stuttering John was on Stephanie Miller’s show with Alonzo Bodden and couldn’t make Alonzo laugh once, but it wasn’t from a lack of trying. Annie joins us for a round of “Opie or Burr,” she reads some recent reviews, and finish with your voicemails.
Watch this episode here: https://youtube.com/live/QFvpZxYBOtw

item.title: Ep727 - The Sound Affect w/Artie Fletcher
item.description:
Artie Fletcher is a ridiculous human who thinks he had a career in stand up, acting, and music. And he’s so braggadocious. He might actually surpass Stuttering John in that category. And when it comes to hitting on the only woman on the show… chef’s kiss from StutJo.
Vinnie Paulino joins us to show everyone Artie’s biggest TV commercial ever, for Eclipse gum, and how that made him their spokesperson in interpersonal relationships. Kevin Brennan clowns Ray DeVito’s stand up, which would be fine, but he does it with Tom Myers. KarmicX got dumped by Felicia Gillespie and he takes full responsibility because he was doing “drugs.” Bill Burr went to a restaurant and coffee shop in Atlanta… no further questions!! This guy couldn’t make his life seem more boring. Good thing he’s not an entertainer. Oh wait. Opie had a big F U Friday episode that exposed the fact that he doesn’t even know what an entertaining podcast could possibly sound like. At least he’s making money on superchats… that reference WATP. D’oh!! We finish with Internet News and voicemails.
I cohost a fun show with Vinnie: https://thecreepoff.com/
Support us, get bonus episodes, and watch live every Saturday and Wednesday:

item.title: Ep726 - Simpcast Fallout, Opie & Ron, Whitney Cummings, Richard Marx and Daisy
item.description:
We start off with a brand new video from the home of Richard Marx and Daisy Fuentes. These two horn-balls are at it again. Bragging about their sex lives while trying to sell you on Richard’s ridiculous new box set. Seriously, who has a box set anymore?
Chrissie Mayr had a disastrous stream with Melonie Mac last week. She tried to make things right by having Brittany Venti on Simpcast. It couldn't have gone worse. Chrissie tries to be the victim, the martyr, and the hero. It doesn't work that way! Whitney Cummings continues to make a podcast for no one as she tries to piece together jokes about aliens and the ocean. Opie is so jealous of the guys he used to know becoming more successful that he can’t even pretend anymore. This time it’s Kevin Hart. Annie joins us for a round of “Opie or Burr” and your voicemails.
Watch this episode here: https://youtube.com/live/RJjuS-2vh6w

item.title: Ep725 - The Pic-a-Flic Podcast
item.description:
We’re always excited to talk about Cam Sully, the host of the Jacked Up Review Show! We found him as a guest on another ridiculous podcast all about the Muppets. He brought his buddy Oreo Brewer and together they couldn’t make a worse team. Fortunately, they’re both wildly unprepared.
Earl David Reed is live in studio with us and decided to not murder Chris and me for making him watch this show. We check in on how bad Tim Heidecker is doing now that’s he’s playing the Alex Jones character before watching Brendan Schaub explain that all of his podcast friends have passed him by. Bill Burr interviewed Jason Newsted who hasn’t been relevant since 1996. But Bill knows music! He’s a music geek! So the conversation is top-notch. Stuttering John gets choked up talking about how amazing he is/was. We finish with the internet news and your voicemails.
Earl David Reed - https://comedianearldavidreed.com/

item.title: Minisode - Opie Meets Ron
item.description:
Adam Busch and I did an impromptu episode because we recently discovered a livestream of the day Opie met Ron the Waiter. It’s wild. Ron stole the show. Opie and Carl Ruiz were getting dinner (before 5) at Pete’s Tavern. Ron sees that they’re livestreaming and decides it’s his chance to become a star. And boy was he right!

item.title: Ep724 - Beth on Howard Stern, Opie & Ron, Stuttering John, Rob Saul Joins
item.description:
Howard Stern had his wife Beth on to promote her new children’s book. As she explains hers and Howard’s lifestyle, it becomes very apparent that they’re both suffering from extreme mental illness. Beth’s new cause is domesticated rabbits for some reason. Also, it’s never been more apparent that Robin is completely out of it and should really just retire at this point.
Blind Mike had to lecture KC Day in the middle of his show and it made our Cringe of the Week. KarmicX lost his channel and is either over it or extremely upset about it depending on when you ask him. Rob Saul joins the show after he sperged out this week, striking channels all over the place. Opie is trying to pit his two cohosts against each other as he praises Tony P and even goes to see him perform stand up. Stuttering John watched us rip his 911 calls so explains that his hands were tied and actually he did the right thing when he called the police on a DoorDash delivery driver. Annie joins us for a round of “Opie or Burr” and we finish up with voicemails.

item.title: Ep723 - True Crime Obsessed
item.description:
This week we’re revisiting a true crime show that was wildly popular. True Crime Obsessed is hosted by a woman with no personality and an over-the-top gay guy who is completely insufferable. Together they run the laziest true crime show possible.
Pat Dixon joins us to discuss how Drew Barrymore is so Drew Barrymore. KC Armstrong lands in our cringe of the week and Fartmouth wants us to review them again. Frenchie Hana recorded an unboxing video that literally breaks all the rules of unboxing videos. Pat tries to figure out what Tom Myers is talking about. Stuttering John is taking medication for his hair loss but now his dick doesn’t work.

item.title: Ep722 - StutJo Calls 911, Bryan Callen, Opie & Ron, Earl Skakel Joins Us
item.description:
This is a Stuttering John heavy show as we watch his “final week” on the internet unfold. It’s amazing to watch how John would handle an intervention as OG Mumbling Nick softly mentions John might have a problem and it turns into a long list of excuses, deflections, and whataboutisms.
Opie is really making sure that his cohost Ron is not happy. Everything from Ron’s childhood to his excitement about going to the Patrice O’Neal benefit needs to be thoroughly dismissed. Earl Skakel joins the show to talk about Brendan Schaub’s comedy career. Earl worked the clubs with Schaub, Callen, and D’Elia. Bryan Callen read some negative reviews of his special and handles it about as poorly as possible. Chris D’Elia is trapped doing a podcast that has one-tenth the audience it used to have. Stuttering John literally called 911 twice on the DoorDash delivery guy who was persistent. We play the calls! Megan and Annie join us for “Is It Gay?” and a special relationship edition of “Opie or Burr?” We finish with some comments, reviews, and voicemails.
Watch this episode here: https://youtube.com/live/qOX_x61FboM
Earl Skakel’s YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/earlskakel

item.title: Ep721 - The Artie Fletcher Show
item.description:
This week we’re checking in on Artie Fletcher, the man who is currently teaming up with Stuttering John to perform live comedy shows. Artie used to have a weekly radio show and a comedy tour with Bob Nelson and Gallagher. His local TV appearances are more cringe than Tom Myers.
Vinnie Paulino is in studio to laugh at Brendan Schaub getting tricked into proving he knows nothing about cars. Harrison Smith from Infowars is a fan of WATP. The Quartering thinks his content is getting suppressed because of YouTube and not because his content is boring and confusing. Steve Grillo finally figured out that Stuttering John is not a good friend and ends their relationship in the most childish way possible. Stuttering John received a DoorDash who was persistent and he ended up calling the police about it. The return of ClayDabbler is outstanding as Clay absolutely crushes John Melendez.

item.title: Ep720 - Brendan Schaub Ends TFATK, Opie & Ron, Stuttering John
item.description:
This week we start off briefly checking in on Rob Saul, KarmicX, Mario Bosco, and Boyd Tinsley. Then we check in on Brendan Schaub who doesn’t hold back as he explains Bryan Callen is the reason why The Fighter and the Kid isn’t very good anymore. He has an argument with Chin that is bonkers as they discuss how young you have to be in order to be “silly” on a podcast.
Adam Busch brings in the Cringe of the Week with Corey Feldman celebrating his Bar Mitzvah on the streets of Beverly Hills and Aaron Imholte’s thoughts on Satanic pop music. Opie’s friend Ron the Waiter is shooting a pilot for television (allegedly) and Opie wants to talk about anything else. Then they have a guest on their show and get into an embarrassing fight in front of him. Stuttering John’s lolsuit had a big decision today that we discuss. We listen to John sing about how the Dabbleverse is dying in the way only the musically untalented and dimwitted StutJo can. Megan and Annie join to play a round of “Is It Gay?”, the “Opie or Burr” game, and Cardiff’s “To Poke A Dabbler.” We finish with reviews, comments, and voicemails.
Watch this episode here: https://youtube.com/live/tqblxXFLmC8

item.title: Ep719 - The Quartering
item.description:
This week we’re checking in on the Quartering, a long-time streamer who is embroiled in controversy this week. Jeremy Hambly is a wealthy man who puts out a ton of low effort content (his words). Now he’s upset that people are making fun of him and he’s flagging channels and using connections at YouTube to get revenge.
Trucker Andy and Lucy Tightbox both join the show to discuss Kino Casino’s battle with the Quartering and Jeremy’s stolen shorts content. Stuttering John had both Ava and $2 Corky on his show. Ava asks $2 Dan straight up what his role was in the relentless bullying of Patrick Tomlinson. Corky can't defend himself and Stuttering John can't follow anything that Ava is saying. John associating with Corky is a terrible idea considering his track record. Ava comes off as brilliant compared to StutJo and Corky. Opie can’t control his show at all. What’s normally an FU Friday stream that’s pure fire is derailed by a discussion of whether or not mermaids are real. We finish off with a round of “To Poke A Dabbler” and your voicemails.
Trucker Andy’s show: https://staysorry.com/
Cayley’s show: https://www.youtube.com/onceoverwithcayley
Support us, get bonus episodes, and watch live every Saturday and Wednesday:
⁠⁠http://bit.ly/watp-patreon⁠⁠

item.title: Ep718 - Club Random w/Andy Dick, Stuttering John, Opie, KarmicX, Tom Myers
item.description:
Bill Maher had Andy Dick on his show and had to explain to him that his career is over. Andy was apparently the last to know. He’s trying though, he even wrote some limericks to read on Bill’s show.
KarmicX was totally sperging out over Hackamania and the shows that actually prepare content. Tom Myers was off for over four months and spent that time writing zero jokes as evidenced by this recent monologue. Opie and Ron made a new friend who has been in the comedy scene for decades but doesn’t appear to know anything about Opie. Stuttering John has his most pathetic glory days walk down memory lane yet. Megan and Annie join us for a round of “Is It Gay?” and “Opie or Burr.” We finish up with reviews, comments, and your voicemails.
